name: Validate a complex simulation
short_description: Validate a simulation with interacting uncertainty, sensitivity, calibration, and independent holdout evidence.
self_assessment: I can validate one complex simulation without help using four independent checks.
description: Validate a simulation with interacting uncertainty, sensitivity, calibration, and independent holdout evidence. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Challenge a simulation with sensitivity and holdout tests
